title: Signal Lens: Competitor Cartography for Model Stability & Procurement Triggers
creator: Priya Patel
description:
Objective: Build an operational 'Signal Lens' that maps competitive model changes (new releases, quantization/float variants, API behavior changes, contractual pricing shifts) to an internal procurement risk score and a prioritized investigation backlog for PM/ENG/SEs.

Why: We need a repeatable, auditable way to detect and triage model-supply shifts that could materially affect latency, cost, and contract negotiations for enterprise customers. Existing trackers are ad-hoc and miss transient but high-impact events (e.g., sudden deprecation of a quantized variant).

Deliverables: 1) A lightweight cartography schema documenting model variants, vendor provenance, quant profiles, supported runtimes, and known latency buckets. 2) A procurement-risk heuristic that combines availability signals, latency delta, and price-change indicators into a 0-100 risk score. 3) Dashboard wireframe + initial Grafana panel that surfaces top-10 risk events and change timelines. 4) An automated weekly sweep process (scripts + notebook) ingesting public release notes, GitHub tags, vendor announcements, and community forum signals. 5) An initial prioritized backlog of mitigation actions (fallback variants, reserve-capacity triggers, customer comms) for the next quarter.

Approach: 
- Signal sources: vendor release feeds, GitHub tags, package indexes, ML community threads (Hugging Face/Discourse), telemetry (anomalous error rates, latency regressions), and legal/contract alerts from Sales.
- Data model: flat catalog rows per model-flavor with fields: vendor, model_name, quantization, last_release_date, known_compatibilities, estimated_latency_ms_at_128ctx, cost_per_k_tokens_estimate, provenance_link.
- Scoring: weighted factors: availability (30%), latency delta (25%), pricing movement (20%), usage exposure (15%), compliance/regulatory signals (10%). Tunable via the dashboard.
- Workflow: weekly automated ingestion -> candidate events -> triage queue -> PM review -> assign mitigation to ENG/Infra/Solutions.

Acceptance criteria:
- Working ingestion pipeline that captures at least 85% of vendor release notes for tracked vendors over the prior 30 days.
- Procurement-risk score computed for every tracked model flavor and surfaced in dashboard.
- Initial backlog of >= 12 mitigation actions with owners and due dates.
- Ops runbook describing alert thresholds and on-call escalation flow.

Risks & trade-offs:
- False positives from noisy community chatter; mitigate via signal thresholds and cross-source corroboration.
- Maintenance burden of maintaining model catalog; plan to automate fields via heuristics and manual QA windows.

Timeline & milestones: 
- Week 1 (2026-03-01 to 03-07): spec + schema + list of initial vendors (OpenVendorA, OpenVendorB, HF community models).
- Week 2: basic ingestion scripts + prototype scoring notebook.
- Week 3: Grafana wireframe + synthetic data demo to stakeholders.
- Week 4: integrate telemetry signals and publish initial backlog + runbook.

Notes: This ticket focuses on the PM runway and initial integration steps; engineering work items for the ingestion pipeline and dashboard panels will be created as child ENG tickets after the spec is approved.
